verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI building blocks rather than an in-product insights feature: inference endpoints, OpenAI chat completion pass-through, RAG systems, and an 'AI apps and agents' API. Users could use these to build their own insight generation, and a community comment notes machine learning exists as a paid add-on. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product. Missing for 10: a documented in-product AI assistant or insight/suggestion feature, a description of what insights are generated from user data, and hands-on corroboration.
